status: Analysis choices fixed after the N1000 four-seed pilot and before examining the prospective N2000 or N4000 group outcomes.
scope: Focused empirical validity assessment of the existing conditional EI prediction; no fitted finite-size correction and no formal all-orders claim.
primary_groups: N1000 four fresh seeds per composition
N2000 twelve fresh seeds per composition
N4000 four fresh seeds per composition
sampling_units: Independent seed clusters. Realizations generated from the same seed across fractions or sizes may be dependent even when no matched network structure is apparent. Never pool those realizations as independent for cross-condition inference.
within_condition_inference: Report mean, network SD, SE, and conventional two-sided 95% Student-t mean intervals for nu, covariance energy and dimension fraction; report every realization and state outcome. These are finite-record sampling intervals, not deterministic error bounds.
between_condition_inference: For common seeds use paired per-seed differences and paired intervals. First four seed clusters are the prespecified size/fraction pairing set. Additional N2000 seeds improve within-point precision but do not become unpaired entries in a matched contrast.
accuracy_reporting: Report absolute and relative discrepancy intervals for nu, energy, d and population energies separately. Interval inclusion of the theory is not equivalence. Describe the quantitative domain by the precision actually obtained; do not silently convert a non-rejection into an accuracy claim. Any optional 20% relative-error margin is a descriptive yardstick, not an analytic bound, and requires the full interval inside that margin before the corresponding observable is called consistent to that precision.
size_trend: Report paired N1000-to2000 and N2000-to4000 differences on seeds3001to3004 and whether ingredient errors decline. Do not select a power-law exponent from these few sizes or fit an amplitude correction to PR.
ingredient_tests: analytic time-averaged gains and selected cross-block checks
same-neuron static/source moment decomposition on prespecified retained seed3001 networks
state_handling: Keep every sampled realization. Fixed-point covariance is zero and PR undefined. Periodic and irregular fluctuating states must remain labeled; low variance alone does not classify a network as frozen.
limitations: Stationarity and mutual window independence are assessed by duration/gap diagnostics but not proved. The finite-record mean-free covariance-energy identity does not make the PR ratio exactly unbiased. Four-network largest-size intervals can remain broad. A residual is retained if the size series does not identify a supported correction or validity regime.
